blueprints.title: FCPS-II theory: single-best MCQ paper
blueprints.notes: 2012 prospectus: Paper II is 100 single-best MCQs in 3 hours. Radiopaedia describes the current theory as two BCQ papers; the current count and time come from each CPSP notification. CPSP publishes no negative marking and no fixed pass mark for this paper. The per-system mix follows your approved past-paper weights (even until you approve some).

blueprints.title: FCPS-II theory: short-answer paper
blueprints.notes: 2012 prospectus: Paper I is 10 short-answer questions in 3 hours. Newer descriptions list two BCQ papers, so whether an SAQ paper is still sat is unverified.

blueprints.title: FCPS-II TOACS: image stations
blueprints.notes: Computer-based, image-based assessment of 30 stations covering all modalities (Radiopaedia). Time per station is not published here; 5 minutes per station is an assumption.

blueprints.title: FCPS-II viva: system tables
blueprints.notes: Six system-related vivas with six examiners on three tables, two systems per table (Radiopaedia). Total time is an assumption.

blueprints.title: IMM theory: MCQ paper
blueprints.notes: CPSP IMM guideline, computer-based Diagnostic Radiology: Paper I and Paper II each 100 MCQs in 2 hours. One paper per mock. Core content is physics, anatomy and basic pathology (Radiopaedia).

blueprints.title: IMM TOACS: image stations
blueprints.notes: IMM TOACS follows the theory within 2-3 weeks (CPSP). Radiopaedia describes a computer-based image TOACS of 30 stations; the IMM station count and time are unverified.

blueprints.title: Final FRCR Part A: SBA paper

mix.label: Genito-urinary, adrenal, obstetrics and gynaecology, and breast
Central nervous system and head and neck

blueprints.notes: RCR: two papers of 120 SBA questions (five options), 3 hours each, six areas; +1 correct, 0 incorrect (no negative marking). Pass mark set per sitting by modified Angoff and Hofstee, so none is fixed. Equal shares for the six areas are an assumption.

blueprints.title: Final FRCR Part B: short-case reporting
blueprints.notes: RCR (from June 2025): 25 plain-radiograph cases in 120 minutes, each scored out of 5; CXR 50-60%, MSK 40-50%, AXR up to 4%; about 25% paediatric. Pass standard set per sitting.

blueprints.title: Final FRCR Part B: long-case reporting
blueprints.notes: RCR: 6 multi-modality cases (CT, US, MR, radionuclide) in 75 minutes, each scored out of 5.

blueprints.title: Final FRCR Part B: oral
blueprints.notes: RCR: 60 minutes with two pairs of examiners, 6 cases per 30-minute session (12 in total), domain-based marking.
